# Model contract

For one broad cell type, candidate discovery is run globally and independently
in every condition. For target `g`, the exact edge union is

\[
E_g^\cup = E_g^{global} \cup \bigcup_c E_g^{(c)}.
\]

Every condition then fits the same model:

\[
Y_{igc}=\alpha_{gc}+\sum_{r\in E_g^\cup}\beta_{rgc}
E_{i,t(r),c}A_{i,p(r),c}+\varepsilon_{igc}.
\]

RNA and ATAC layers must be preprocessed before condition splitting. The final
fit uses Gaussian identity GLM, `interaction = ":"` and `scale = FALSE`. Thus
all conditions share predictor definitions, units and conditioning covariates.
No global-coefficient calibration is applied.

# Automatic route

```r
fit_object <- infer_condition_grn(
  grn_object,
  cell_type_col = "cell_type",
  condition_col = "condition",
  genes = metabolic_genes,
  tf_cor = 0.1,
  peak_cor = 0,
  min_cells_per_condition = 300L,
  small_condition_action = "error",
  adjust_method = "BH",
  padj_threshold = 0.05,
  rank_action = "mark",
  min_residual_df = 1L,
  parallel = TRUE
)
```

The resulting condition networks are ordinary Pando `Network` objects. Their
coefficient tables include:

```text
tf target region edge_id estimate std_err statistic pval padj
significant penalty_effect direction estimable zero_variance aliased
```

`estimate` is the complete fitted condition effect. `penalty_effect` equals
`estimate` only where `padj < 0.05`; otherwise it is zero. An unavailable
coefficient remains `NA` and is not treated as an estimated zero.

# Manual two-stage route

```r
edges_global <- discover_grn_edges(
  grn_object,
  genes = metabolic_genes,
  cells = cells_cell_type,
  source_label = "global",
  source_type = "global"
)

edges_condition <- setNames(lapply(condition_levels, function(level) {
  discover_grn_edges(
    grn_object,
    genes = metabolic_genes,
    cells = cells_by_condition[[level]],
    source_label = level,
    source_type = "condition"
  )
}), condition_levels)

edge_dictionary <- union_grn_edges(edges_global, edges_condition)

for (level in condition_levels) {
  grn_object <- fit_grn_from_edges(
    grn_object,
    edge_dictionary = edge_dictionary,
    cells = cells_by_condition[[level]],
    condition_label = level,
    network_name = paste0("condition_grn__", level),
    adjust_method = "BH",
    padj_threshold = 0.05,
    rank_action = "mark"
  )
}
```

The union is over complete triples. TF, peak and target node sets must not be
unioned separately and recombined.

# Standard fallback

With no usable condition column or one condition level, `infer_condition_grn()`
runs original per-cell-type Pando GLMs and stores
`condition_coefficients_calculated = FALSE`.

# Projection

```r
fit <- condition_grn_fit(fit_object, cell_type = "T_cell")
projection <- project_condition_grn_cells(
  fit_object,
  fit = fit,
  significant_only = TRUE
)
metacell <- aggregate_condition_grn_projection(
  projection,
  membership,
  group_col = "metacell_id"
)
```

Projection uses paired single cells before aggregation. The coefficient test is
conditional on the selected dictionary; candidate-selection uncertainty is not
included in the ordinary GLM P value.
